correctness.llamacpp_natural_scope: external speed comparator; HIP base/MTP output ledgers match, while Vulkan base/MTP ledgers differ and Vulkan MTP is published only as a labeled speed comparator, not an exactness result

limitations: Prefill and fixed-shape decode are artificial repeated-token throughput controls; natural MTP uses the full multi-prompt suite.
llama.cpp B1-B5 are selected independently by full-suite transition throughput; hipEngine uses its retained exact/default B3.

llama.cpp HIP MTP output ledgers match its AR control at every budget. Vulkan MTP output ledgers differ from its AR control at every budget, so the Vulkan MTP column is a labeled external speed-only comparator, not an exact-output claim.
